channel.title: Vifug blog
channel.description: Practical articles on presentation software for churches and live events.

item.title: Presenting Bible verses well on screen
item.description: Practical advice on translation choice, verse chunking, references, multiple languages and pace, with an offline Bible in 31 English versions and more.

item.title: How AI auto-follow works, and what it cannot do
item.description: An honest look at speech-following for lyrics and Scripture: what it can do, where it fails, Deepgram versus on-device engines, and keeping the operator in charge.

item.title: Training new media team volunteers in four weeks
item.description: A four-week onboarding plan for new church media volunteers, with roles, a one-page checklist, rehearsal habits and calm Sunday-morning routines.

item.title: Choosing worship backgrounds: stills, motion and legibility
item.description: How to pick still or motion backgrounds for worship slides, keep them legal and light on the computer, and keep the words readable, with Vifug as the example.

item.title: How to choose presentation software: a practical checklist
item.description: A step-by-step checklist for choosing presentation software, covering team skill, hardware, offline use, streaming, import and support, with a scoring table.

item.title: Different pictures for the room and the online audience
item.description: Why the room needs full-screen words while online viewers need a lower third over the camera, and how to send each audience its own picture.

item.title: Stage display and multiple screens for church services
item.description: Plan confidence monitors, lobby and overflow screens that each show different content, and set them up with Vifug's stage display and per-screen themes.

item.title: How many lines of a song should go on each slide?
item.description: Two lines or four? How line length, phrasing and repeated choruses should decide your lyric slide breaks, and the lines-per-slide control in Vifug.

item.title: Best free presentation software for churches: what to look for
item.description: A fair look at free church presentation software: the categories, what free usually costs you, and a checklist to test any option before Sunday.

item.title: Livestream lyrics with OBS, vMix and NDI
item.description: How a transparent lyrics overlay reaches OBS, vMix or an NDI receiver, what each path needs, and how to set it up with Vifug without a capture card.

item.title: Setting up a projector and second screen for church
item.description: How to cable a projector, choose mirror or extend, match resolution and aspect ratio, test brightness, and assign the output screen in Vifug.

item.title: Designing lyric slides people can read from the back row
item.description: Font, size, contrast, outlines, safe margins and reading distance for lyric slides, with the exact settings to use in Vifug's theme designer.

item.title: What is presentation software? Types, uses and how they differ
item.description: A plain explanation of presentation software: slide tools, worship and live-production tools, and signage, and what each kind is actually good at.
